name: qm
install: git clone --branch v0.1.15 <repo> && build as deploy/core/Dockerfile does (npm ci --omit=dev, connector-sdk build); see Dockerfile
entry: /opt/harness/adapter.sh run | serve (task container in compose.yaml; HE_ENTRY selects it)
turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:'U1'}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:<trial>}, text:<instruction.md>} signed with CORE_SIGNING_SECRET
inner_harness: pi by default; HE_HARNESS_CONFIG selects (configs below). HARNESS env on core, read at src/config.ts:1022-1026 (mock|pi|claude; unset = mock)
state_paths: sandbox volume qm-home-<scope> (/root, the agent's workspace; removed by capture.sh)
mcp_config_path: QM's MCP server registry: PUT /v1/admin/mcp-servers/world at serve start (name world, url HE_WORLD_MCP_URL, auth bearer with HE_WORLD_MCP_TOKEN, credentialScope shared, readOnly false), as admin principal harness-admin (ADMIN_GRANTS in config/core.env); core probes tools/list before saving
sandbox_backend: local (one Docker container per scope via the host socket; image Dockerfile.sandbox)
multi_user_mode: QM scopes: personal:<slack user id> for a DM, channel:<id> for a channel; the actor is the requester's Slack user id on every turn
serve_turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:<requester slack_user_id>, displayName}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:'dm:<member>'} | {kind:'channel', threadRef:'channel:<id>', channelRef:<id>, channelName}, text:<prompt>}

serve.session_key: conversation.threadRef dm:<member> | channel:<id>; scope personal:<actor> | channel:<id>. With TurnRequest.thread_ts set (a task turn with thread = "new"), :t<thread_ts> is appended, which opens a new QM session in the same scope
serve.shared_between_sessions: whatever QM shares across scopes under HARNESS_SHARING_POSTURE=isolated; not configured by the adapter
serve.exit_mapping: status ok, silent or pending_approval -> 0; request outlived the budget -> 124; refusalKind model_budget or a provider status in reason -> 3; else 2. A pending_approval turn keeps exit 0 and its TurnResult (pendingApprovals) is in <turn>.qm.json
serve.memory_snapshot: before every turn the adapter reads GET /v1/admin/memory/scopes and GET /v1/admin/memory?scope=<id> for each scope with memory, as harness-admin, into <turn>.memory.json (observation for the probe report; a failure is logged, never a turn failure)

gbrain_mcp: with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL and HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN set at serve start, PUT /v1/admin/mcp-servers/gbrain (name gbrain, url HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL, auth bearer with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN, credentialScope shared, readOnly false) as harness-admin, beside world; core probes tools/list before saving, so the registration's 2xx is the discovery proof (qm-gbrain-register.json). Unset, no registration happens

inner_harnesses.pi: QM's vendored pi-ai loop (src/harness/pi-harness.ts); PI_MODEL from HE_MODEL_NAME; the configuration every earlier QM cell ran
inner_harnesses.claude: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.280 (package.json:70) driven by src/harness/claude-harness.ts: Claude Code's tools, skills and settings are off, QM's tools are bridged as the only MCP server, permissionMode bypassPermissions, no persisted session (claude-harness.ts:425-476); the SDK's native Agent delegation stays on when the turn is not read-only and does not delegate work (allowSubagents, claude-harness.ts:333, 440-466). CLAUDE_MODEL from HE_MODEL_NAME (config.ts:1521). The child process receives ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (claude-harness.ts:93-109), so every request goes through the metering proxy. Fallback note: an unsupported CLAUDE_MODEL id falls back to the SDK default in silence (claude-harness.ts:298-304); the runner's model assertion (HE-MODEL-001) and the proxy allowlist catch it. This cell measures QM's two shipped integrations, not Claude Code as a product
inner_harnesses.codex: none at this pin. Codex is only a ChatGPT-subscription model provider inside the Pi harness (src/harness/pi-harness.ts CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER, src/model/codex-device-login.ts), not an inner harness; HARNESS accepts mock|pi|claude. The Codex cell of the brief is recorded as a finding (internal-task)
inner_harnesses.claude_side_traffic: Rig limitation observed 2026-10-24 (internal-task smokes): the Claude Code CLI the Agent SDK spawns sends HEAD /api/hello to the configured base URL (the proxy refuses it, model null, counted in usage.refused) and opens direct TLS connections to api.anthropic.com from the core container for endpoints its binary hardcodes (/api/event_logging/v2/batch, /api/oauth/claude_cli/roles, /api/web/domain_info); CLAUDE_ENV_PASSTHROUGH (claude-harness.ts:93-109) carries no telemetry switch. The child holds only the per-trial dummy token and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is the proxy, so model requests cannot bypass metering; tolerated and recorded, not fixed

configs.pi: QM_HARNESS=pi; MEMORY_CAPTURE_QUIET_MS 180000 (shipped default, src/memory/strategies/per-turn.ts:9). Held-out cells
configs.pi-strict: pi-probe plus QM_PROBE_CONFIG=pi-strict: before the first turn the adapter PUTs {posture: "strict"} to /v1/admin/scopes/org:harness-eval/security-posture as harness-admin (qm-admin-security-posture.json holds the 2xx). strict also lifts the auto posture's private-network deny (security-posture.ts:16-20); the probe does not depend on that
configs.pi-command-deny: pi-probe plus QM_PROBE_CONFIG=pi-command-deny: PUTs a denylist command policy whose first rule denies \buname\b, followed by the shipped org floor rules (command-policy.ts:7-22), to /v1/admin/scopes/org:harness-eval/command-policy (first match wins, command-policy.ts:888-895; qm-admin-command-policy.json holds the 2xx)
configs.mapping: harnesses/qm/prepare.sh maps HE_HARNESS_CONFIG to QM_HARNESS, QM_MEMORY_CAPTURE_QUIET_MS and QM_PROBE_CONFIG as NAME=value lines compose interpolates; an unknown value exits 2

memory_capture_quiet_ms: 5000 in probe configs, 180000 (shipped) otherwise. Deviation, probe cells only: QM captures memory after a quiet period following a turn; at 180 s nothing is captured before a probe's next turn arrives, so the probe cells shorten it and their task turns wait 20 s. The held-out cells keep the shipped value
capture: capture.sh copies and removes every qm.sandbox container of org harness-eval (manifest qm-sandboxes.json with sha256), then starts pg under COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME and writes pg_dump of database qm to logs/qm-db.sql.gz (session_entries, tool_calls, llm_prompt_envelopes, memory). The dump holds per-trial tokens and is never committed
org_scope: org:harness-eval (ORG_ID=harness-eval in config/core.env; orgScope() at src/config.ts:943)
